properties.displayName: Configure Log Analytics workspace data retention (workspace level)
properties.description: Governs the workspace-level analytics data retention (retentionInDays) of Log Analytics workspaces against the number of days you specify. Audit flags workspaces whose retention differs from that value; configuration is handled by the Automation runbook or script, not by policy remediation. If no value is supplied, the target retention defaults to 30 days, which is the minimum retention period for a Log Analytics workspace.

metadata.description: The policy effect. Only Audit is supported: it reports workspaces whose retention does not match the specified value without changing anything.

Workspace-level analytics data retention in days. This becomes the default analytics retention for all Analytics tables that still inherit the workspace setting. Allowed range is 30-730. Defaults to 30 (the minimum).
